notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.300
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors.  
Thank you for playing Orbcraft Survivors.[/p]

[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]  
This patch includes improvements to the Perk system and the addition of new achievements.

[h1][b]Patch Details[/b][/h1]  
[list][*][p][b]System Improvements[/b]  
From the moment you acquire a Perk, it will automatically be equipped to an Orb by default.  
New achievements related to the automatic Perk equip function have been added.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.268
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors.  
Thank you for playing Orbcraft Survivors.[/p]

[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This patch includes skill and monster balance adjustments as well as buffs to some Perk attributes.

[h1][b]Patch Details[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][p][b]Balance Adjustments[/b]

Some values for skills and monsters have been adjusted.

Certain Perk attributes have been buffed as follows:
　- Reduces enemy movement speed by 30% for 1 second (previously 1% freeze chance → changed to 3% freeze chance)  
　- 10% chance to increase the number of single projectiles +1 → 10% chance to increase the number of projectiles +1[/p][/*]
[/list]

[p]We will continue our efforts to provide a better gaming environment. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.267
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors.  
Thank you for playing Orbcraft Survivors.  
Here are the changes we've applied:[/p]

[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]  
This patch includes adding a mouse aiming feature in settings, balance adjustments, and fixing a bug with certain projectiles.

[h1][b]Patch Details[/b][/h1]  
[list]
[*][p][b]New Features[/b]  
- Added mouse aiming feature in the settings.[/p][/*]

[*][p][b]Balance Changes[/b]  
- Improved damage scaling application to include attack increase Perks. (Example: +1 → +5)[/p][/*]

[*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b]  
- Fixed an issue where certain projectiles would orbit in place. (Example: Reactive Magic Bullet)[/p][/*]
[/list]

[p]We hope this patch helps provide smoother gameplay.  
We sincerely appreciate your valuable feedback and bug reports,  
and will continue doing our best to offer a more polished gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.266
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors.

Thank you for playing Orbcraft Survivors.
Here are the changes we've applied:[/p]

[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
This patch includes approximate 5x scaling adjustments to damage and monster HP, Perk and Talent balance, interface improvements, skill visibility, and reward balance.

[h1][b]Patch Details[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][p][b]Combat Balance[/b]
Damage and monster HP scaling has been adjusted to approximately 5 times compared to before.
(Percentage-based Perk effects are now applied more effectively.)[/p][/*]
[*][p][b]Perk Related[/b]
Fixed an issue where the projectile speed increase effect was not applied correctly.[/p][/*]
[*][p][b]Talent Related[/b]
Adjusted the maximum HP increase from +10 per rank to +5% per rank.
Increased the base EXP gain range by approximately 33.3%.[/p][/*]
[*][p][b]Interface Improvements[/b]
Added a photosensitivity warning confirmation function triggered by mouse input.[/p][/*]
[*][p][b]Graphics Improvements[/b]
Adjusted the transparency of the reactive explosion effect to improve character visibility.[/p][/*]
[*][p][b]Rewards Related[/b]
Increased the probability of dropping more gold.[/p][/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.25
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors.

Thank you for playing Orbcraft Survivors.  
Here are the changes we've applied:[/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1][list][*][p]This patch includes improvements to the Perk system, orb balance adjustments, zombie speed changes, and updates to the beginner guide.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Patch Details[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Perk System[/b][/p][list][*][p]If there is a known combination in the Perk selection, the resulting combination icon will be shown.[/p][/*][*][p]When viewing combinations in-game, your currently owned Perks will be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the inventory order would rearrange in a specific way when replacing Perks. Now, replacements will reflect the exact changed position.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Orb Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]To emphasize the uniqueness of the Sky Orb, the projectile speed of the Shadow Orb has been decreased (to maintain many projectiles).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Zombies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zombies now move slightly slower.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Beginner Guide[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated hotkeys related to the beginner guide.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.23
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors.

Thank you for playing Orbcraft Survivors.  
Here are the changes we've applied:[/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1][list][*][p]This patch includes improvements to the tutorial, adjustments to monster and orb balance, and talent system expansion for higher quality and better game balance.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Patch Details[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Tutorial & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]The display duration of the tutorial key guide has been increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the in-game BGM would continue playing after stage completion.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Combat & Monsters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Extended the pre-spawn effect duration for monsters from 1 second to 1.6 seconds to allow for more ample player response time.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased the overall movement speed of monsters.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Orb Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Electric Orb I, II, III have been adjusted downward overall.[/p][list][*][p]We have addressed the previously underappreciated benefits of Electric Orbs (such as minimal impact from projectile speed, reliable targeting, and superior damage focus).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Talent System[/b][/p][list][*][p]EXP gain range: 5 stages, +10% per stage (up to 50%)[/p][/*][*][p]Character movement speed: 5 stages, +2% per stage (up to 10%)[/p][/*][*][p]Projectile speed: 5 stages, +2% per stage (up to 10%)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes – Ver. 1.0.1.22
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
This update addresses a critical issue that prevented the game from launching when the Windows system language was set to certain languages, such as French.

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]

Fixed a launch-blocking bug caused by specific Windows language settings.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
Thank you for your patience and continued support for Orbcraft Survivors!

notes.title: Demo Update Ver 1.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Stage 1 has been updated to Stage 2, and a new stage has been added.
[*]Stop Mode is now available after leveling up, allowing for strategic play.
[*]Clearing Stop Mode in each stage unlocks Non-Stop Mode challenges.
[*]UI improvements provide a better user experience.
[*]A beginner's guide has been added to assist new players.
[*]Languages added: Español (MX), Italiano, Português, Русский, ไทย.
[/list]
